items.title: DTCC expands eligible collateral for tokenized MMFs
items.summary: Updated schedule recognises selected tokenized USD money-market funds as eligible margin for certain cleared products. Published haircuts 2–5% by structure and transfer-agent controls.
items.implication: Improves booking and margin efficiency for global cash books.

items.title: Securitize expands BUIDL dealing capacity
items.summary: Transfer agent raised daily capacity. Settlement remains T+0 against USDC in the existing 24/7 window for eligible institutions.
items.implication: Higher operational throughput for large flows.

items.title: ISDA guidance on tokenized-fund CSA treatment
items.summary: Clarifies how tokenized short-term government and money-market shares may be treated under existing CSA language when the underlying is eligible.
items.implication: Reduces legal friction for bilateral collateral use.

items.title: Ondo USDY crosses $2.3B on-chain
items.summary: Ondo’s yield-bearing note remains one of the largest tokenized USD products by distributed value across multiple chains.
items.implication: Confirms continued institutional and crypto-native demand for yield-bearing cash alternatives.
